speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: Wait, I cannot diagnose gastroenteritis as it does not explain the neurological deficits. The MRI results will be critical to rule out a frontal lobe tumor or vascular lesion causing these focal signs and personality changes. REQUEST TEST: Brain_MRI

speaker: Doctor
text: The MRI findings of disseminated white matter lesions suggest a demyelinating process like Multiple Sclerosis, but the rapid progression and prominent behavioral changes are atypical. Do you have a history of alcohol misuse or poor dietary intake, as these symptoms could indicate Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Known history of HIV, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Noncompliance with medications for over 2 years. Social history: Information not provided

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of untreated HIV and these neurological symptoms, I suspect an HIV-associated opportunistic infection or neurocognitive disorder. REQUEST TEST: HIV_Viral_Load

speaker: Doctor
text:
The high viral load and disseminated white matter lesions strongly suggest Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) caused by JC virus reactivation in the setting of untreated HIV.
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy
